42 likes, 4 comments - the_temptationalley on February 19, 2026: "This salad is super creamy and delicious. You can include it in weight loss too. It’s high in protein. If you are vegan and don’t eat egg, then replace egg with firm tofu and replace yogurt with vegan yogurt. 
.
The chopped (peeled) soft-boiled eggs
- 1/2 Avocado
- 2-3 tbsp diced onions
- 2-3 tbsp diced jalapeños
- Handful of scallions
- 2- 3 tsp Dijon mustard
- 1.5 tbsp Greek yogurt/ hung curd
- 1 tbsp chilli oil 
- 1 tbsp hot sauce ( if you can’t handle spice skip it )
- 1/2 tbsp lemon juice
- 2-3 tsp sesame seeds
- Pinch of salt and Italian seasoning 
.
Try it for your breakfast or brunch and thank me later. 
.
#highproteinmeals 
( weight loss, high protein diet, meal preparation, meals idea, salad, avocado toast, vegan food )".

87 likes, 5 comments - the_temptationalley on February 10, 2026: "These dumplings are super easy to make and zero efforts required. The only preparing time you need is to fold the dumplings.
.
Ingredients- 1/4 cup capsicum finely chopped 
- 1/2 cup corn 
- 1 tsp Italian seasoning 
- salt as per taste 
- 7-8 rice paper sheets 
- cheese of your choice ( don’t use soft cheese ) I used Emmental cheese 
.
Steam for 5-8 mins I used boiled corn here and enjoy.
.
#dumplings #gyoza".

29 likes, 4 comments - the_temptationalley on February 8, 2026: "Toast so good that even my kitchen towel could not resist eating it 😅😂 I have seen people trying persimmons and making viral persimmon cake / pudding but I so wanted to try something different and honestly I am glad I did. This is such a flavourful recipe.
.
Spicy, sweet and creamy at the same time.
.
Ingredients- 2 sourdough bread 
- 1 avocado 
- 1/2 onion and 1 tomato small 
- 1/4 tsp chilli flakes 
- 1 tsp lemon juice 
- salt as per taste 
- 1 persimmon 
- 1 tbsp feta crumble
- 1/2 tsp hot honey or normal honey 
.

24 likes, 1 comments - the_temptationalley on February 6, 2026: "If you want to include veggies in your diet this is the best way to do it. I also sometimes add tofu to make it high protein. 
.
If you make this white bean burger let me know if you like it I have mentioned the ingredients below - 
.
White Bean Veggie Burger Recipe

🧾 Ingredients

For the Tikkis (Patties)
1 cup boiled white beans (or chickpeas)
2 medium boiled potatoes (aloo)
¼ cup bread crumbs
½ tsp chilli flakes
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp red chilli powder
Salt to taste

- For the Coleslaw
1 cup shredded white cabbage
½ cup shredded purple cabbage
½ cup grated carrot
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tsp Dijon mustard
Salt & pepper to taste

- For the Burger Assembly
Burger buns (lightly toasted)
Cheese slices (any kind — cheddar or mozzarella works great)
Onion (sliced into rings)
Capsicum (thinly sliced)
Mayo-ketchup mix (2 parts mayo + 1 part ketchup)
Butter (for toasting buns)
.
#veganburger #veganburgers #veganfoodspot #vegansofinstagram #veggieburger vegeterianfood veggieburger whitebeans chickpeaburger".

22 likes, 1 comments - the_temptationalley on February 3, 2026: "It’s 2025 and going to 2026 soon. If you still think salads are boring wait until you try this salad. It’s perfect for large party gatherings and comes together in no time.
.
You can add orange juice instead of lemon juice and add capers if you have it will elevate the flavour of the recipe. 
.
Note - I have not added salt as I added in beans while blanching but if you need salt toh can definitely add it.
- make sure you Blanche your beans in heavy salted water and immediately keep it in ice cold water ( Blanche for 3-4 mins ) beans should not be mush it needs to have crunch. 
- I have boiled the potatoes before airfrying it. ( Airfryer for 10 mins at 200 * ) 
.
Ingredients - 2 -3 handful of beans 
- 3 potatoes 
- 2 garlic 
- 1/2 onion 
- 3 olives chopped 
- 1 tbsp honey 
- 2 tbsp lemon juice 
- 1 tsp Dijon mustard 
- 5-6 tbsp olive oil 
- 3-4 tbsp corn 
- 1/2 tsp oregano and 1/2 tsp chilli flakes 
.
#saladsofinstagram #saladrecipe #beansalad #greenbeans #healthyfoodrecipes highproteinmeals whatiateforlunch whatieatinday whatsforlunch mediterraneanflavors crispypotatoes crispypotato".
